about: Stills for the fresh editorial home page direction (2026-11-01). Generated through scripts/generate-assets.mjs with --manifest assets/fresh/editorial.manifest.json. Founder approved all image creation in chat on 2026-11-01.

defaults.suffix: Photoreal, documentary, natural light, soft contrast, true colour, fine film grain. One continuous shot, slow and physical camera move, no cuts. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, neon, lens flare, bokeh circles, light orbs, purple, glowing orbs or rockets. Phone and laptop screens are never visible to the camera.
defaults.stillSuffix: Editorial documentary photograph for a long-form magazine feature, shot on 35mm film, Kodak Portra 400 colour, soft natural light, muted greens, slate blues and warm wood tones with warm true skin, gentle film grain, true skin texture with pores, natural hands with five fingers. Unposed, the subject does not look at the camera. No text, letters, numbers, logos, crests, brand marks or watermarks anywhere, including on clothing, signs and devices. Phone and laptop screens face away from the camera and are never visible. No paper, notebooks, worksheets, pencils, printed books or calculators. No purple, neon or lens flare.
